newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed futures slip, seen bouncing back.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed futures slip, seen bouncing back.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery dropped further to 1,127/1,128 rupees per quintal from 1,131/1,132 rupees on fresh speculative selling, traders said.
Sluggish overseas demand, higher supplies and reports of progress of monsoon in the producing centres prompted fresh bull liquidation, they said.
"Technically however market is now oversold and short covering may help prices to bounce back," one operator said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 357/358 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes while offtake remained dull.
"Arrivals were low in the Bombay market due to heavy rain in the producing centres," one miller said.
Imported palm oil slid by 1/2 rupees to 267/268 rupees per 10 kg on fresh arrivals at the Bombay port.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 545/550 rupees per 15 kg.
